insets.note: MEASURED: statusBars frame [0,0][1080,76] = 76 px and navigationBars frame [0,2281][1080,2408] = 127 px, converted at the effective density 2.6875 to 28.3 / 47.3 dp. The cutout is 100 x 76 px, top-centre waterdrop, centre x = 540 which is exactly half of 1080. Kotlin still reads live window insets at runtime; these values are the fallback, not the source.

density.note: MEASURED on the physical POCO M5 running stock HyperOS, pasted by the operator 2026-10-15. `wm density` reports Physical density 440 AND Override density 430. 430 is the EFFECTIVE density the framework reports, so dp maths uses it. Re-run with --density 440 to model the panel with no HyperOS override, which gives frameDp [392.7, 875.6] instead of [401.9, 896.0].
